question: Is there an official UPLB library discovery and access route for the unretrieved 1993 PCAMRD reservoir-fisheries proceedings that a non-UP researcher can use?

target.title: Reservoir Fisheries Management and Development in the Philippines
target.publisher: Philippine Council for Aquatic and Marine Research and Development (PCAMRD)
target.requestedChapter: L.R. Balite, Status of Fish Production and Management of Fisheries in the Reservoirs of NPC Hydroelectric Power Plants (HEPs); page range unresolved between citations 11-20 and 21-52.

sourcesReviewed.finding: The official UP library catalog page links to the UPLB Koha catalog at koha.uplb.edu.ph.
sourcesReviewed.directQuery: A read-only exact ISBN search was attempted through the catalog search endpoint over HTTP and HTTPS; both returned HTTP 403 in this environment. This does not show whether a catalog record exists.
sourcesReviewed.access: Official catalog link verified; exact holdings not verified.

sourcesReviewed.finding: The revised 2024 UPLB Citizen's Charter lists the Main Library Article Request Service for Non-UP clients. It describes email/webmail requests, partner-library searching if unavailable, and a seven-working-day route when a print item needs scanning. Its fee table states no fee when available online and lists scanning rates for Non-UP clients; applicability to this specific proceedings chapter and any current price must be confirmed by the library.
sourcesReviewed.contact: The official UPLB Library booklet lists universitylibrary.uplb@up.edu.ph and the Main Library phone numbers +63 998-537-2407 / +63 998-867-8251.
sourcesReviewed.access: Official 2024 charter and 2024 library booklet reviewed online.

limits: The catalog search could not be read because the endpoint returned HTTP 403; no inference about the presence or absence of a holding is made.
The Article Request Service is described for articles; the library must confirm whether it handles this proceedings chapter or can refer the requester to the holding location.
The revised 2024 charter may not reflect current fees or processing details; request a current quotation before authorizing any paid scan.
No login, email, web form, payment, scan request, personal information, or access-control workaround was used.
nextAction: Joseph can send a short availability inquiry to universitylibrary.uplb@up.edu.ph with the title, editors, publisher, year, series, ISBN and Balite chapter title. Ask whether they hold the proceedings, whether a non-UP request can cover the chapter, whether any partner library has it, what the current fees are, and whether the library permits research use of a scan. Do not pay or request redistribution until the library confirms the terms.
